steps.text: Instead of drawing real components, scientists use simple symbols in circuit diagrams. Let's learn to read them.
Tap each symbol to see what it stands for — the cell, the bulb, the switch, and the wires.
Now read a diagram and answer: with the parts connected in a closed loop and the switch on, what happens? The bulb glows.
A circuit diagram is just a neat map of a real circuit. Once you know the symbols, you can read or draw any simple circuit.

coach.mission: Learn the circuit symbols and read a diagram.
whenStuck: Tap each symbol to match it to its real component.
Then trace the diagram as a loop and see if it's complete.
whenWrong: Match each symbol to its part, then check if the loop is closed.
A closed loop with the switch on makes the bulb glow.
whenCorrect: Right — you read the symbol correctly.
Good — you can trace the diagram as a real circuit.
coach.done: You've learned to read circuit diagrams. Explore more, or move on when you're ready.
